card.name: Start of a year number
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before the rest of a four-digit year, such as 1815, 1953 or 2012, in dates, citations and life spans. It fires on the token that opens the year.

modes.label: Space before a year
modes.description: A bare space token right before a year after a word like in, by or after.
modes.example: Ginsberg was able to get the book published as a pulp paperback in<< >>1953 under the pseudonym

modes.label: First digit of a year
modes.description: The leading digit 1 or 2 of a year inside parentheses or a citation, with the remaining digits following.

card.writes: It promotes month and time-span tokens and suppresses unrelated word endings, which suggests it helps shape how the rest of a date is written.
card.plain: It fires at the start of a year number, just before the remaining digits of dates like 1953 or 2012.
